editor.premise: A home-working day becomes an evening work session, a late-night reset, and preparation for returning to school.

chapters.name: Delivery arrival
chapters.purpose: Begin with a physical reveal and its conversational explanation.

chapters.name: Making a drink
chapters.purpose: Turn an unboxing into a process with a tasting payoff.

chapters.name: Work and appointment
chapters.purpose: Compress daytime work and acknowledge an interruption.

chapters.name: Evening update
chapters.purpose: Explain the extended workday before returning to action.

chapters.name: Dinner and work
chapters.purpose: Show food preparation giving way to sustained nighttime work.

chapters.name: Midnight check-in
chapters.purpose: Register elapsed time and explain the next morning's plans.

chapters.name: Night reset
chapters.purpose: Convert tomorrow's plans into practical preparation, then close the night.

chapters.name: Morning preparation
chapters.purpose: Resume packing and introduce a sponsored tablet-use demonstration.

captions.note: Small lower-center subtitles track speech; centered activity labels and timestamps mark transitions. Occasional floating asides punctuate reactions without replacing the main subtitle line.

editor.notes: Cut preparation into short, legible changes; hold the finished drink and tasting longer. Let evening explanations breathe between jump cuts. Revisit the same desk from wider and closer angles to make elapsed time visible.
